case_title: STEVEN S. MIYAKE, ESQ VS. JUDY LEE

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $8,759.20 FILED BY MIYAKE, ESQ, STEVEN S. AS TO DEFENDANT LEE, JUDY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-07-2022 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-07-2022 - CONTINUED TO FEB-25-2022 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506, AT THE REQUEST OF THE PLAINTIFF.
ORDER TO CONTINUE FOR PROOF OF SERVICE.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-25-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO APR-15-2022 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF STEVEN MIYAKE, ESQ. IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT JUDY LEE IS PRESENT. UPON QUESTIONING THE DEFENDANT ON SERVICE IT WAS FOUND TO BE IMPROPER. NO PROOF OF SERVICE FILED. DEFENDANT WILL NOT WAIVE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE DATE $200) SERVED MAR-20-2022, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT LEE, JUDY
CORRESPONDENCE -PLACED IN FILE RECEIVED BY DEFENDANT LEE, JUDY

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-15-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUL-01-2022 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF STEVEN S. MIYAKE IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT JUDY LEE IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT JUDY LEE'S EX PARTE COMMUNICATION RECIEVED BY THE COURT TO JUDGE TONG WAS RETURNED TO DEFENDANT IN COURT AND NOT VIEWED BY THE JUDGE. PARTIES AGREE TO A SETTLEMENT FOR THE AMOUNT $4,507.50 (INCLUSIVE OF COURT COSTS). DEFENDANT TO PAY BY CHECK WITHIN 45 DAYS. PROGRESS REPORT DATE IS SET. NO APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED IF PAYMENT IS MADE AS AGREED. APPEARANCES ARE REQUIRED IF PAYMENT HAS NOT BEEN RECEIVED AS AGREED AND JUDGMENT WILL BE ISSUED. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER OF CONTINUANCE FOR PROGRESS REPORT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF STEVEN S MIYAKE IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT JUDY LEE IS PRESENT. SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT WAS REACHED ON APRIL 15, 2022. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM WILLIAM LYNN; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
